pages.text: $(bold)Redwire Posts$() and $(bold)Bundled Cable Posts$() carry a line up and over obstacles on a slim pole; the $(bold)Post Plates$() and $(bold)Relay Plates$() let wires branch and hand off cleanly where they meet.
pages.title: Routing

pages.text: Between posts, plates, and the $(bold)Soldering Table$() (next chapter), More Red lets you wire a base the way an electrician would — in conduit, not spaghetti.
pages.title: Tidy by Design
